name: Calcasieu Parish, LA
findings: Calcasieu Parish has 531 nonprofit organizations. 180 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 137 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Calcasieu Parish has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Calcasieu Parish list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 196 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
